adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar)` occurs **before any `await`** inside the `async` mapper passed to `users.slice(1).map(...)`. That means the `push` happens synchronously during the `map` loop, in the same order as `users.slice(1)`, not in Promise resolution order. Also, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized with `[eventType.destinationCalendar]` or `[organizerUser.destinationCalendar]` (so the organizer/eventType calendar is index 0), and only afterwards `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` appends team calendars, preserving index 0.
